title: De la Vallée Poussin type approximation for solving some Fredholm integral equations
summary: In the present paper, we introduce a numerical method for second-kind Fredholm integral equations (FIEs) based on de la Vallée Poussin-type (VP) polynomial approximations at Jacobi zeros. This class of approximations offers several advantages over classical Lagrange interpolation at the same nodes. In particular, it guarantees uniformly bounded Lebesgue constants in suitable weighted function spaces and provides near-best uniform approximation for functions in these spaces, while also significantly mitigating the Gibbs phenomenon.
